source_refs.note: Roman Urdu: practice mcqs written from Unit 3 (PDF 73-125), not printed in the book; same questions and order as the English set. Drafts needing academic review.

blocks.text: Yeh Unit 3 (Integration) ke poore unit se practice MCQs hain, unit ke sections ki tarteeb mein. Har sawal ka aik sahi jawab hai aur saath mukhtasar wajah, jis mein hal ke qadam diye gaye hain.

blocks.prompt:
1 A function \(F\) is an antiderivative of \(f\) on an interval \(I\) when, for all \(x\) in \(I\):
(Function \(F\), interval \(I\) par \(f\) ka antiderivative (ulta derivative) kab kehlata hai? Jab \(I\) ke har \(x\) ke liye:)
blocks.explanation: Definition ke mutabiq \(F'(x) = f(x)\) ho to \(F\), \(f\) ka antiderivative hai: \(F\) ko differentiate karein to \(f\) wapas mile.

book_ref.quote: A function \(F\) is called an antiderivative of a given function \(f\) on an interval \(I\)

blocks.prompt:
2 Which one of the following is an antiderivative of \(3x^{2} + 4\)?
(In mein se kaun sa \(3x^{2} + 4\) ka antiderivative hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{d}{dx}(x^{3} + 4x + 7) = 3x^{2} + 4\); constant 7 ka derivative zero hai. Baqi options ke derivatives \(6\), \(3x^{2}\), \(9x^{2} + 4\) hain.

book_ref.quote: is also an antiderivative of \(f(x)\) on that interval

blocks.prompt:
3 The set (family) of all antiderivatives of \(f\) is called:
(\(f\) ke tamam antiderivatives ke set (family) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Tamam antiderivatives ki family \(\int f(x)\,dx = F(x) + c\) ko indefinite integral (ghair muayyan takamul) kehte hain.

book_ref.quote: is called the indefinite integral of \(f(x)\) with respect to \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
4 In \(\int (x^{2} + \cos x)\,dx\), the expression \(x^{2} + \cos x\) is called the:
(\(\int (x^{2} + \cos x)\,dx\) mein \(x^{2} + \cos x\) ko kya kehte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Integral sign ke andar likha function integrand kehlata hai.

book_ref.quote: inside the integral sign is the integrand

blocks.prompt:
5 \(\int 5t^{4}\,dt\) equals:
(\(\int 5t^{4}\,dt\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(dt\) batata hai ke variable \(t\) hai, is liye jawab \(t\) mein: \(t^{5} + c\). \(+c\) ke baghair sirf aik antiderivative milta hai.

book_ref.quote: It indicates the variable of integration

blocks.prompt:
6 A student writes \(\int 2\sin 2x\,dx = \cos 2x + c\). Differentiating the answer shows that it is:
(Aik talib-e-ilm likhta hai \(\int 2\sin 2x\,dx = \cos 2x + c\). Jawab ko differentiate karne se pata chalta hai ke yeh:)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{d}{dx}(\cos 2x) = -2\sin 2x\) (sign ghalat). \(\frac{d}{dx}(-\cos 2x) = 2\sin 2x\), is liye sahi jawab \(-\cos 2x + c\).

book_ref.quote: Always check an integral by differentiating the answer

blocks.prompt:
7 \(\int 4x^{-5}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int 4x^{-5}\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(4\int x^{-5}\,dx = 4\cdot\frac{x^{-4}}{-4} + c = -\frac{1}{x^{4}} + c\) (power mein 1 jama, nayi power se taqseem).

book_ref.quote: add 1 to the power, then divide by the new power

blocks.prompt:
8 \(\int \sqrt[3]{x}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sqrt[3]{x}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: First write roots and reciprocals as powers.

blocks.prompt:
9 The power rule \(\int x^{n}\,dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + c\) cannot be used when:
(Power rule \(\int x^{n}\,dx = \frac{x^{n+1}}{n+1} + c\) kab istemal nahin ho sakta?)
blocks.explanation: \(n = -1\) par nayi power \(0\) hoti hai aur \(0\) se taqseem mumkin nahin. Is ke liye \(\int \frac{1}{x}\,dx = \ln|x| + c\) hai.

book_ref.quote: the new power is 0 and we would divide by 0

blocks.explanation: \(4x^{3}\), bracket \(x^{4} - 3\) ka derivative hai, is liye General Power Rule se \(\frac{(x^{4} - 3)^{6}}{6} + c\).

book_ref.quote: multiplied by the derivative of what is inside the bracket

blocks.prompt:
11 \(\int \frac{3x^{2} + 2}{x^{3} + 2x + 1}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{3x^{2} + 2}{x^{3} + 2x + 1}\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Numerator \(3x^{2} + 2\), denominator ka derivative hai; Rule-4 se \(\ln|x^{3} + 2x + 1| + c\).

book_ref.quote: the integrand is a fraction whose numerator is the derivative of its denominator

blocks.prompt:
12 \(\int \frac{x^{2}}{x^{3} + 4}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{x^{2}}{x^{3} + 4}\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Derivative \(3x^{2}\) hai, sirf \(x^{2}\) mojood; \(\frac{1}{3}\) bahar rakh kar Rule-4: \(\frac{1}{3}\ln|x^{3} + 4| + c\).

book_ref.quote: If the numerator is the derivative only up to a constant factor, fix the constant with Rule-1

blocks.prompt:
13 \(\int (5x - 2)^{3}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int (5x - 2)^{3}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: The derivative brings out an extra factor

blocks.prompt:
14 \(\int e^{3 - 2x}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int e^{3 - 2x}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: It works only for a linear inside

blocks.prompt:
15 Which one of the following statements is correct?
(In mein se kaun sa bayan sahi hai?)
blocks.explanation: Sirf constant (yahan 7) bahar aa sakta hai. \(x^{2}\) constant nahin, product ko alag nahin kar sakte, aur General Power Rule ke liye \(2x\) zaroori hai.

book_ref.quote: Only a constant may be taken out.

blocks.prompt:
16 \(\int (4x^{3} - \sin x + 2)\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int (4x^{3} - \sin x + 2)\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Har term alag: \(x^{4}\), \(+\cos x\), \(2x\); aakhir mein aik \(+c\).

book_ref.quote: Integrate each term separately and write one

blocks.prompt:
17 \(\int \csc^{2}x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \csc^{2}x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{d}{dx}(\cot x) = -\csc^{2}x\), is liye \(\int \csc^{2}x\,dx = -\cot x + c\) (minus sign yaad rakhein).

book_ref.quote: The same happens for \(\csc^{2}x\) and \(\csc x\cot x\).

blocks.prompt:
18 \(\int 5^{x}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int 5^{x}\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\int a^{x}\,dx = \frac{a^{x}}{\ln a} + c\), \(a = 5\). Variable exponent mein hai, is liye power rule nahin lagta.

book_ref.quote: because differentiating \(a^{x}\) multiplies by

blocks.prompt:
19 \(\int \sec 2x\tan 2x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sec 2x\tan 2x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\int \sec x\tan x\,dx = \sec x + c\); \(2x\) ke liye \(2\) se taqseem.

book_ref.quote: every row also works for \(ax + b\) in place of \(x\)

blocks.prompt:
20 Which function has derivative \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\)?
(Kis function ka derivative \(\frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\) hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(\frac{d}{dx}(\sin^{-1}x) = \frac{1}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\). (\(\cos^{-1}x\) ka derivative is ka manfi hai.)

blocks.prompt:
21 For \(x > 1\), \(\int \frac{dx}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}\) equals:
(\(x > 1\) ke liye \(\int \frac{dx}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 1}}\) barabar hai:)

22 \(\int \cot 3x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \cot 3x\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: In the same way \(\int \cot x\,dx = \ln|\sin x| + c\)

blocks.prompt:
23 \(\int \sin^{2}x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sin^{2}x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\sin^{2}x = \frac{1 - \cos 2x}{2}\) se \(\frac{x}{2} - \frac{\sin 2x}{4} + c\). \(\sin x\) ki power ko \(x\) ki power ki tarah integrate nahin karte.

book_ref.quote: \(\int \sin^{2}x\,dx = \frac{x}{2} - \frac{\sin 2x}{4} + c\) (our additions

blocks.prompt:
24 \(\int \sec 4x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sec 4x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\int \sec x\,dx = \ln|\sec x + \tan x| + c\); \(4x\) ke liye 4 se taqseem. \(-\frac{1}{4}\ln|\cos 4x|\) to \(\tan 4x\) ka integral hai.

book_ref.quote: a standard trick: multiply and divide by \(\sec x + \tan x\)

blocks.prompt:
25 \(\int \sin 5x\cos 3x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sin 5x\cos 3x\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: and turn products into sums (Example 10)

blocks.prompt:
26 \(\int \frac{2^{x} + 3^{x}}{6^{x}}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{2^{x} + 3^{x}}{6^{x}}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: use the laws of exponents to write each term as a single power

blocks.text: 3.2 Method of Substitution or Change of Variable

blocks.prompt:
27 For \(\int x^{2}\sqrt{x^{3} + 1}\,dx\) the best substitution is:
(\(\int x^{2}\sqrt{x^{3} + 1}\,dx\) ke liye behtareen substitution kaun si hai?)
blocks.explanation: Root ke andar wala hissa \(u = x^{3} + 1\) lein; \(du = 3x^{2}\,dx\) aur \(x^{2}\,dx\) pehle se mojood hai.

book_ref.quote: usually the inside of a power, a root, an exponent, a logarithm or an inverse function

blocks.prompt:
28 \(\int x^{2}\sqrt{x^{3} + 1}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int x^{2}\sqrt{x^{3} + 1}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Choose \(u\) as the "inside" expression

29 \(\int \sin^{4}x\cos x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sin^{4}x\cos x\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: and the integrand must all be written in

blocks.prompt:
30 \(\int \frac{\cos x}{e^{\sin x}}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{\cos x}{e^{\sin x}}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Substitute back \(u = g(x)\) and check by differentiating

blocks.prompt:
31 \(\int \frac{(\ln x)^{3}}{x}\,dx\), \(x > 0\), equals:
(\(\int \frac{(\ln x)^{3}}{x}\,dx\), \(x > 0\), barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: The process of replacing \(x\) with a new variable

blocks.prompt:
32 \(\int \frac{e^{\sin^{-1}x}}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{e^{\sin^{-1}x}}{\sqrt{1 - x^{2}}}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: The method stems from reversing the Chain Rule for derivatives.

blocks.prompt:
33 \(\int \frac{\tan^{-1}x}{1 + x^{2}}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{\tan^{-1}x}{1 + x^{2}}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: (or a constant multiple of it) sitting as a factor elsewhere in the integrand

blocks.prompt:
34 \(\int x^{3}\cos(x^{4})\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int x^{3}\cos(x^{4})\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: A missing constant factor is fixed by multiplying inside and dividing outside

blocks.prompt:
35 With \(u = x + 3\), the integral \(\int x\sqrt{x + 3}\,dx\) becomes:
(\(u = x + 3\) rakhne se \(\int x\sqrt{x + 3}\,dx\) kya ban jata hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(du = dx\) aur \(x = u - 3\); har \(x\) ko \(u\) mein likhein: \(\int (u - 3)\sqrt{u}\,du\). Variable \(x\) bahar nahin nikal sakta.

book_ref.quote: If the derivative is not present, write \(x\) itself through \(u\)

blocks.prompt:
36 For an integral containing \(\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\), the suitable substitution is:
(Jis integral mein \(\sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\) ho, us ke liye munasib substitution:)
blocks.explanation: Constant minus variable: \(a = 4\), is liye \(x = 4\sin\theta\); root \(4\cos\theta\) ban jata hai.

book_ref.quote: How to choose: look at the sign pattern under the root.

blocks.prompt:
37 With \(x = 5\tan\theta\) \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\), \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 25}\) becomes:
(\(x = 5\tan\theta\) \(\left(-\frac{\pi}{2} < \theta < \frac{\pi}{2}\right)\) se \(\sqrt{x^{2} + 25}\) kya banta hai?)

book_ref.quote: can frequently be reduced to a simpler form by using the substitution \(x = a\tan\theta\)

blocks.prompt:
38 \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{9 - x^{2}}}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Special integrals to remember

blocks.prompt:
39 \(\int \frac{dx}{16 - x^{2}}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{16 - x^{2}}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Mixing up the two log formulas

blocks.prompt:
40 \(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2} - 36}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{x^{2} - 36}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: (i) \(\int\frac{1}{x^{2}-a^{2}}\,dx = \frac{1}{2a}\ln\left|\frac{x-a}{x+a}\right| + c\)

blocks.prompt:
41 \(\int \frac{dx}{4 + x^{2}}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{4 + x^{2}}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Hints for the Challenge: (i) as in Proof (i)

blocks.prompt:
42 \(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 49}}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{\sqrt{x^{2} + 49}}\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Formula \(\ln\left|x + \sqrt{a^{2} + x^{2}}\right| + c\), \(a = 7\); \(-\ln 7\) constant \(c\) mein shamil.

book_ref.quote: appears; it is absorbed into \(c\)

blocks.prompt:
43 If \(x = 2\sec\theta\), then \(dx\) equals:
(Agar \(x = 2\sec\theta\) ho to \(dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Replace \(dx\) too: \(dx = a\cos\theta\,d\theta\)

blocks.prompt:
44 For \(x > 4\), \(\int \frac{dx}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 16}}\) equals:
(\(x > 4\) ke liye \(\int \frac{dx}{x\sqrt{x^{2} - 16}}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Formula (v) as printed holds for \(x > a\).

blocks.prompt:
45 In the substitution \(x = a\sin\theta\), \(\theta\) is kept in \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) because there:
(\(x = a\sin\theta\) mein \(\theta\) ko \(\left[-\frac{\pi}{2}, \frac{\pi}{2}\right]\) mein kyun rakhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: Is range mein \(\cos\theta \ge 0\), is liye root \(a\cos\theta\) hai (minus ke baghair) aur \(\theta = \sin^{-1}\frac{x}{a}\) aik hi hai.

book_ref.quote: On this range \(\cos\theta \ge 0\)

blocks.prompt:
46 Integration by parts is the integral form of the:
(Integration by parts kis rule ki integral shakal hai?)
blocks.explanation: Product Rule \(\frac{d}{dx}[f(x)h(x)] = f(x)h'(x) + h(x)f'(x)\) ko integrate karne se yeh formula milta hai.

book_ref.quote: The rule that corresponds to the Product Rule for differentiation is called integration by parts.

blocks.prompt:
47 \(\int x\cos x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int x\cos x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Pehla \(x\), doosra \(\cos x\): \(x\sin x - \int \sin x\,dx = x\sin x + \cos x + c\).

book_ref.quote: we differentiate one factor (making it simpler) and integrate the other

blocks.prompt:
48 In \(\int x^{2}\ln x\,dx\), which function should be taken as the first function (the one we differentiate)?
(\(\int x^{2}\ln x\,dx\) mein pehla function (jise differentiate karte hain) kaun sa lein?)
blocks.explanation: \(\ln x\) ko differentiate karna aasan hai magar integrate karna mushkil; ILATE mein yeh algebraic se pehle aata hai.

book_ref.quote: A popular memory word (not in the textbook) is ILATE

blocks.prompt:
49 \(\int x^{2}\ln x\,dx\), \(x > 0\), equals:
(\(\int x^{2}\ln x\,dx\), \(x > 0\), barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: the first should become simpler when differentiated

blocks.prompt:
50 \(\int e^{x}(\sin x + \cos x)\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int e^{x}(\sin x + \cos x)\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = \sin x\), \(f'(x) = \cos x\): \(\int e^{x}[f + f']dx = e^{x}\sin x + c\).

book_ref.quote: The most used case is \(g(x) = x\)

blocks.prompt:
51 \(\int e^{x}\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{x^{2}}\right)dx\) equals:
(\(\int e^{x}\left(\frac{1}{x} - \frac{1}{x^{2}}\right)dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(f(x) = \frac{1}{x}\), \(f'(x) = -\frac{1}{x^{2}}\); bracket \(f + f'\) hai, is liye \(\frac{e^{x}}{x} + c\).

book_ref.quote: So whenever the integrand is \(e^{g(x)}\) times a bracket of this shape

blocks.prompt:
52 \(\int \tan^{-1}x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \tan^{-1}x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: \(\tan^{-1}x \times 1\) likh kar by parts: \(x\tan^{-1}x - \frac{1}{2}\ln(1 + x^{2}) + c\).

book_ref.quote: \(\sqrt{x^2 \pm a^2}\) is written as (function) \(\times\) 1

blocks.prompt:
53 \(\int e^{x}\cos x\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int e^{x}\cos x\,dx\) barabar hai:)
blocks.explanation: Do dafa by parts: \(I = e^{x}\sin x + e^{x}\cos x - I\), is liye \(2I = e^{x}(\sin x + \cos x)\).

book_ref.quote: call the integral \(I\), bring the \(I\) terms to one side and solve for \(I\)

blocks.prompt:
54 \(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 9}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 9}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Three ideas make this proof work

blocks.prompt:
55 \(\int \sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \sqrt{16 - x^{2}}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: For (i) the known integral is

blocks.prompt:
56 To evaluate \(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 2x + 5}\,dx\), the integrand is first written as:
(\(\int \sqrt{x^{2} + 2x + 5}\,dx\) ke liye integrand ko pehle kis shakal mein likhte hain?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 2x + 5 = (x + 1)^{2} + 4\): plus sign hai, is liye \(\sqrt{u^{2} + k^{2}}\) wala formula, \(u = x + 1\), \(k = 2\).

book_ref.quote: complete the square. A plus sign between the square and the constant inside the root

blocks.prompt:
57 The correct form of the partial fractions of \(\frac{2x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}(x + 3)}\) is:
(\(\frac{2x + 1}{(x - 1)^{2}(x + 3)}\) ke partial fractions (juzvi kasoor) ki sahi shakal:)
blocks.explanation: Repeated factor \((x - 1)^{2}\) ke liye do fractions, aur \(x + 3\) ke liye aik.

book_ref.quote: In general \((x - a)^k\) needs \(k\) fractions.

blocks.prompt:
58 The correct form of the partial fractions of \(\frac{x}{(x + 2)(x^{2} + 4)}\) is:
(\(\frac{x}{(x + 2)(x^{2} + 4)}\) ke partial fractions ki sahi shakal:)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + 4\) irreducible hai (\(b^{2} - 4ac = -16 < 0\)), is liye us par linear numerator \(Bx + C\).

book_ref.quote: Irreducible quadratic factor: linear numerator

blocks.prompt:
59 Which one of these quadratics is irreducible?
(In mein se kaun sa quadratic irreducible (mazeed factor na hone wala) hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(x^{2} + x + 1\) ka \(b^{2} - 4ac = -3 < 0\). Baqi ke discriminants \(4\), \(1\), \(0\) hain, woh factor ho jate hain.

book_ref.quote: is irreducible when \(b^2 - 4ac < 0\)

blocks.prompt:
60 \(\int \frac{dx}{(x - 1)(x + 2)}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{(x - 1)(x + 2)}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: put the roots of the linear factors (each root removes all but one term)

blocks.prompt:
61 \(\int \frac{x^{2} + 1}{x^{2} - 1}\,dx\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{x^{2} + 1}{x^{2} - 1}\,dx\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Is the fraction proper (degree of \(P\) less than degree of \(Q\))?

blocks.prompt:
62 \(\int \frac{dx}{(x - 2)^{2}}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{(x - 2)^{2}}\) barabar hai:)

book_ref.quote: Integrating \(\frac{1}{(x - 3)^2}\) as a logarithm

blocks.prompt:
63 \(\int \frac{dx}{5 - 2x}\) equals:
(\(\int \frac{dx}{5 - 2x}\) barabar hai:)

66 The value of a definite integral is:
(Definite integral (muayyan takamul) ki qeemat kya hoti hai?)
blocks.explanation: \(F(b) - F(a)\) aik number hai; musbat, manfi ya zero ho sakta hai, aur \(+c\) nahin hota.

(\(\frac{d}{dx}\int_{2}^{x} \sqrt{1 + t^{3}}\,dt\) barabar hai:)

(\(\int_{0}^{\pi/3} \cos x\,dx\) barabar hai:)

blocks.explanation: \(du = 2x\,dx\); naye limits \(1\) aur \(2\): \(\frac{1}{2}\int_{1}^{2} u^{3}du = \frac{15}{8}\). Purane limits rakhne se \(\frac{1}{8}\) aata hai.
